info.title: Meridian — semantic .NET application-flow graph generator
info.description: Meridian — semantic .NET application-flow graph generator for Roslyn, DI, MediatR, reflection, and AI agents.

commands.name: agent-summary
commands.description: Summarize graph.json for graph-guided agent orientation.

options.name: --graph
options.description: Input graph.json path. Defaults to meridian-out/graph.json.

options.name: --budget
options.description: Approximate output budget: compact, standard, or detailed.

commands.name: explain
commands.description: Explain a graph node from graph.json.

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Start a local MCP server over a generated graph.json file.

commands.name: path
commands.description: Find a direct-call path between two graph nodes.

commands.name: scan
commands.description: Build meridian-out/graph.json from a .csproj, .sln, or .slnx file.

options.name: --include-tests
options.description: Include likely test projects when scanning a solution.

options.name: --trust-project
options.description: Suppress the MSBuild trust-boundary warning for repositories you trust.
